execution_policy: This JSON is plan data, not a launcher or authorization to stop productive work.
Stage new r2 code only after NEW_HEAD publication verification. Submit each r2 independently only when all of its listed execution_preconditions have been freshly met.
Never stop, remove, drain early, or replace a healthy r1 to make room for r2. If r1 is still active, wait.
If fullbank is complete, submit no r2. If the existing 24h owner is draining/near expiry, this same-owner plan is blocked and needs a separate reviewed owner rollover.
Keep original failed/terminal proofs and partial outputs; finite natural exit is not goal completion. This plan does not label an unobserved terminal/release as verified.
